entries.title: Matthew 21:1
segments: ¶Now when they drew near Jerusalem, and came to Bethphage, at the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,

entries.title: Matthew 21:2
segments: saying to them, "Go into the village opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Loose [them] and bring [them] to Me.

entries.title: Matthew 21:3
segments: "And if anyone says anything to you, you shall say, 'The Lord has need of them,' and immediately he will send them."

entries.title: Matthew 21:4
segments: All this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying:

entries.title: Matthew 21:5
segments: "Tell the daughter of Zion, 'Behold, your King is coming to you, Lowly, and sitting on a donkey, A colt, the foal of a donkey.'"

entries.title: Matthew 21:6
segments: So the disciples went and did as Jesus commanded them.

entries.title: Matthew 21:7
segments: They brought the donkey and the colt, laid their clothes on them, and set [Him] on them.

entries.title: Matthew 21:8
segments: And a very great multitude spread their clothes on the road; others cut down branches from the trees and spread [them] on the road.

entries.title: Matthew 21:9
segments: Then the multitudes who went before and those who followed cried out, saying: "Hosanna to the Son of David! 'Blessed [is] He who comes in the name of the LORD!' Hosanna in the highest!"

entries.title: Matthew 21:10
segments: And when He had come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, "Who is this?"

entries.title: Matthew 21:11
segments: So the multitudes said, "This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth of Galilee."

entries.title: Matthew 21:12
segments: ¶Then Jesus went into the temple of God and drove out all those who bought and sold in the temple, and overturned the tables of the money changers and the seats of those who sold doves.

entries.title: Matthew 21:13
segments: And He said to them, "It is written, 'My house shall be called a house of prayer,' but you have made it a 'den of thieves.'"

entries.title: Matthew 21:14
segments: Then [the] blind and [the] lame came to Him in the temple, and He healed them.

entries.title: Matthew 21:15
segments: But when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that He did, and the children crying out in the temple and saying, "Hosanna to the Son of David!" they were indignant

entries.title: Matthew 21:16
segments: and said to Him, "Do You hear what these are saying?" And Jesus said to them, "Yes. Have you never read, 'Out of the mouth of babes and nursing infants You have perfected praise'?"

entries.title: Matthew 21:17
segments: Then He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and He lodged there.

entries.title: Matthew 21:18
segments: ¶Now in the morning, as He returned to the city, He was hungry.

entries.title: Matthew 21:19
segments: And seeing a fig tree by the road, He came to it and found nothing on it but leaves, and said to it, "Let no fruit grow on you ever again." Immediately the fig tree withered away.

entries.title: Matthew 21:20
segments: And when the disciples saw [it], they marveled, saying, "How did the fig tree wither away so soon?"

entries.title: Matthew 21:21
segments: So Jesus answered and said to them, "Assuredly, I say to you, if you have faith and do not doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but also if you say to this mountain, 'Be removed and be cast into the sea,' it will be done.

entries.title: Matthew 21:22
segments: "And whatever things you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive."

entries.title: Matthew 21:23
segments: ¶Now when He came into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people confronted Him as He was teaching, and said, "By what authority are You doing these things? And who gave You this authority?"

entries.title: Matthew 21:24
segments: But Jesus answered and said to them, "I also will ask you one thing, which if you tell Me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things:

entries.title: Matthew 21:25
segments: "The baptism of John--where was it from? From heaven or from men?" And they reasoned among themselves, saying, "If we say, 'From heaven,' He will say to us, 'Why then did you not believe him?'

entries.title: Matthew 21:26
segments: "But if we say, 'From men,' we fear the multitude, for all count John as a prophet."

entries.title: Matthew 21:27
segments: So they answered Jesus and said, "We do not know." And He said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

entries.title: Matthew 21:28
segments: ¶"But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first and said, 'Son, go, work today in my vineyard.'

entries.title: Matthew 21:29
segments: "He answered and said, 'I will not,' but afterward he regretted it and went.

entries.title: Matthew 21:30
segments: "Then he came to the second and said likewise. And he answered and said, 'I [go], sir,' but he did not go.

entries.title: Matthew 21:31
segments: "Which of the two did the will of [his] father?" They said to Him, "The first." Jesus said to them, "Assuredly, I say to you that tax collectors and harlots enter the kingdom of God before you.

entries.title: Matthew 21:32
segments: "For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him; but tax collectors and harlots believed him; and when you saw [it], you did not afterward relent and believe him.

entries.title: Matthew 21:33
segments: ¶"Hear another parable: There was a certain landowner who planted a vineyard and set a hedge around it, dug a winepress in it and built a tower. And he leased it to vinedressers and went into a far country.

entries.title: Matthew 21:34
segments: "Now when vintage-time drew near, he sent his servants to the vinedressers, that they might receive its fruit.

entries.title: Matthew 21:35
segments: "And the vinedressers took his servants, beat one, killed one, and stoned another.

entries.title: Matthew 21:36
segments: "Again he sent other servants, more than the first, and they did likewise to them.

entries.title: Matthew 21:37
segments: "Then last of all he sent his son to them, saying, 'They will respect my son.'

entries.title: Matthew 21:38
segments: "But when the vinedressers saw the son, they said among themselves, 'This is the heir. Come, let us kill him and seize his inheritance.'

entries.title: Matthew 21:39
segments: "So they took him and cast [him] out of the vineyard and killed [him].

entries.title: Matthew 21:40
segments: "Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those vinedressers?"

entries.title: Matthew 21:41
segments: They said to Him, "He will destroy those wicked men miserably, and lease [his] vineyard to other vinedressers who will render to him the fruits in their seasons."

entries.title: Matthew 21:42
segments: Jesus said to them, "Have you never read in the Scriptures: 'The stone which the builders rejected Has become the chief cornerstone. This was the LORD'S doing, And it is marvelous in our eyes'?

entries.title: Matthew 21:43
segments: "Therefore I say to you, the kingdom of God will be taken from you and given to a nation bearing the fruits of it.

entries.title: Matthew 21:44
segments: "And whoever falls on this stone will be broken; but on whomever it falls, it will grind him to powder."

entries.title: Matthew 21:45
segments: Now when the chief priests and Pharisees heard His parables, they perceived that He was speaking of them.

entries.title: Matthew 21:46
segments: But when they sought to lay hands on Him, they feared the multitudes, because they took Him for a prophet.
